summary: Validated the 4 new Amazon Connect features (simulation mode). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests pass (added TestConnect.test_chat_returns_contact_id_and_appends_timeline, test_metrics_simulation, and expanded status/call sim tests). /api/dealer/connect/status returns mode='simulation' + metrics {AGENTS_ONLINE, AGENTS_AVAILABLE, CONTACTS_IN_QUEUE, OLDEST_CONTACT_AGE} + calls list. POST /call in simulation succeeds without a destination, returns mode='simulation', and appends timeline note to the incident. POST /chat returns {mode:'simulation', contact_id:'CHAT-xxxxxx'} and appends 'Amazon Connect chat/SMS <id> opened by ...' to the incident timeline. GET /metrics returns simulation current + historical (CONTACTS_HANDLED = resolved count, HANDLE_TIME = avg). Frontend (dealer console via seeded JWT in localStorage → /dealer): Amazon Connect tab renders ConnectCCP with mode badge 'Simulation', 4 metric tiles, destination input, 3 agent-state toggles, Place Call button, AND CCPSoftphone placeholder card ('Embedded Softphone' heading + AWS_CONNECT_CCP_URL instructions) because ccp_url is empty. Clicking connect-place-call (empty destination) shows success toast and CALL-xxxxxx appears in Recent Contacts. KPI & Escalation tab renders 'Amazon Connect — Live Contact Metrics' panel with mode badge 'Simulation' and 4 tiles (Contacts in Queue, Handled (1h), Abandoned (1h), Avg Handle Time) ABOVE the category/priority charts. Opening a queue card shows chat-btn ('Start Chat / SMS'); clicking it fires toast 'Chat/SMS opened · CHAT-...' and adds a timeline entry (confirmed via re-fetch). Screenshot confirms toast 'Chat/SMS opened · CHAT-10564D' plus CALL-... and CHAT-... entries in Recent Contacts panel.
critical_code_review_comments: ConnectMetricsPanel testid slug uses /[^a-z0-9]+/g which leaves a trailing dash for 'Handled (1h)' and 'Abandoned (1h)' -> data-testid='connect-kpi-handled-1h-' (trailing '-'). Cosmetic; consider .replace(/^-|-$/g,'').

ConnectCCP: in simulation the Place Call button posts even with an empty destination — intended for demo, but the resulting call has destination:''; recent-contacts row shows only the transcript. Consider defaulting destination to '+1-simulated' or a friendly label in the recent list.

server.connect_call in live mode requires either AWS_CONNECT_SOURCE_PHONE or AWS_CONNECT_QUEUE_ID; the 400 is only surfaced at call time. Consider surfacing this in /connect/status when mode=='live' but neither is configured, so the UI can pre-warn the agent.

connect_live_metrics / historical use blocking boto3 client from within async endpoints — for low volume it's fine, but under load consider running in a thread pool (fastapi.concurrency.run_in_threadpool) to avoid blocking the event loop.
CCPSoftphone: import 'amazon-connect-streams' at module scope will still execute even when ccp_url is empty (adds ~KBs). Consider dynamic import inside the useEffect when ccpUrl is set.

DealerConsole.load includes 'selected' in useCallback deps but the interval was created once with eslint-disable — after 3+ tabs updated the callback identity 'selected' change re-creates load but the setInterval still holds the first closure. Not a bug because setSelected inside load re-syncs, but flagged for clarity.

seed_data_creation: None new. Test run naturally created new INC-*, CALL-* and CHAT-* rows via existing seeded users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests via `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts='' --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. xdist LoadScope from pytest.ini must be overridden. Amazon Connect stack is in SIMULATION until AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY/AWS_REGION/AWS_CONNECT_INSTANCE_ID/AWS_CONNECT_CONTACT_FLOW_ID are set in backend/.env, at which point call requires E.164 destination and either AWS_CONNECT_SOURCE_PHONE or AWS_CONNECT_QUEUE_ID.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. All 4 targeted features (Go-Live keys plumbing via connect_configured, embedded CCP placeholder, live chat/SMS from incident, live-contact-metrics panel) work end-to-end in simulation.
